description:
## Goal

Give every logical source publisher one stable typed `SourceOwner` and every exact name/text/provenance instance one immutable `SourceVersion`. Owner identity answers “which publisher?”; version identity answers “which exact source bytes produced this diagnostic location?” This is the initial identity cutover for ordinary submissions, reserved runtime sources, preludes, and macro-mediated publication. It does not expose live replacement.

## Final model

- Source-publisher jobs, declarations, facts, and lexical ownership use `SourceOwner`.
- Tokens, quoted-node metadata, and diagnostic `Span` use `SourceVersion`.
- `SourceMap` is the sole immutable name/text/provenance authority. `CodeMap` retains only owner publication state pointing at the current immutable version; it has no parallel name/text columns.
- Runtime owners are reserved at bootstrap and materialize source text exactly once, on demand.
- Source-less synthetic/global state is explicit absence. No dummy owner or fake version exists.
- Mixed macro output retains definition and caller versions on the nodes that actually came from each source. Macro publication retains its lexical owner.
- Every untrusted quoted AST node is acquired through `ast_node(&SourceMap)`, which validates its own metadata and returns its resolved optional span. The raw span decoder is private and single-use. Missing metadata remains absent/DUMMY; malformed metadata is an error and is never repaired, restamped from a parent, or reclassified as a shape mismatch. The only production bypass is a narrow frontdoor call-shape check over metadata it just built; test inspection is cfg(test).
- Generated callable code identity is separate from diagnostic provenance. `GeneratedFunctionOccurrence { start, end, peer }` is minted once while lowering the fully expanded owner body; `peer` is the deterministic owner-local occurrence among lambdas with the same range and arity. `FunctionMap` keying and typed `CallableOrderIdentity` share that occurrence. Diagnostic `Span` remains on the function surface. Type ordering compares recursive typed callable identities; rendered labels are display only. No raw source/function id, filename, display string, hash, or mint order is authority.
- Named module/function/type identities remain typed semantic identities. Explicit source/prelude order keeps its language meaning; incidental owner/version allocation cannot change semantic answers or canonical artifacts.

## TDD signal

The production path proves stable owners and immutable versions for named, unnamed, runtime, and prelude sources; exact diagnostic resolution; mixed definition/caller macro provenance; source-less interpreter/JIT parity; malformed ordinary, nested-wrapper, remote-callee, sugar, and token provenance rejection; and cold runtime reservation without source materialization.

Generated-callable tests prove same occurrence rereference is idempotent, same-range peers remain distinct, nested occurrences are owner-relative, unrelated function allocation does not move typed ordering or canonical bytes, and two source-less macro expansions of delayed values evaluate `20 + 22` as `42` rather than conflating both generated bodies into `44`.

## Cutover and deletion

Replace compiler `CodeId` with opaque `SourceOwner` and old `source::Id` with opaque `SourceVersion` in one live cut. Delete source/code ordinal coincidence, `CodeId::from_source`, duplicate CodeMap name/text storage, dummy/detached source identities, filename/display inference, raw `#lambda:...` parsing, string callable-order authority, eager native quote scanning, source-version reconstruction, and compatibility identity paths.

No source mirror, replacement history, rollback state, reconciliation pass, eager graph validation, submit adapter, or live replacement API is introduced. Location-independent replacement remains `fz-tfn.57`; broader executable/provenance separation remains `fz-tfn.40`.

## Accepted evidence

Accepted integrated commit: `16dea0fb2` (`fz-tfn.61: give every source one stable owner and immutable version`) on rebased parent `3504d6c95`.

Reviewed full binary diff SHA-256: `b869c1d0f1293dc5aea536799584ddf81a9d1c8274f3f3faf04b7a708339efec` (81 files, +3,589/−2,034).

The first push was based on an older `fz-lib`. GitHub merge CI run `34183473597` correctly exposed three compile errors in two heredoc tests newly added to PR #122. Stack #126 was imported locally; its top layer was rebased onto current `fz-lib` `e38b7c319`. The original .59, .188, and .82 patch IDs remained byte-equivalent. The .61 patch ID also remained unchanged across the rebase before integrating the two new tests through the established SourceMap/SourceVersion reader API. No overload, adapter, or compatibility helper was added.

Final integrated gates: 1,995 library tests passed / 6 ignored / 0 failed; 642/642 serial fixture cases; 30/30 CLI cases; 225 runtime tests; doctests; exact CI `cargo llvm-cov` all-feature/workspace gate with the line threshold satisfied; workspace all-target/all-feature check; strict Clippy with warnings denied; formatting and diff checks.

A fresh Astra-high, ticket-scoped restack review independently verified the exact new parent/hash, all 1,995 serial library tests, quoted readers, macro products, strict Clippy, the two base-integration tests, and the deletion/authority boundaries. It approved the exact integrated hash without findings. No temporary artifacts or migration debris remain.

## Unblocks

- `fz-tfn.53` publishes each validated source contribution as one typed batch.
title: Give every source one stable owner and immutable version
